title: PDS MPP: Project Manager Assistant
shortDescription: Analyze Microsoft Project plans for delivery insights in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
longDescription:
PDS MPP Project Manager helps project managers, PMO analysts, schedulers, and delivery leads make sense of Microsoft Project schedules in Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams. It turns a detailed project plan into concise, traceable answers, helping teams see delivery concerns and decide where to focus.

Select a supported Microsoft Project (.mpp) plan from OneDrive or SharePoint, or upload one from your device. Ask for a delivery summary, schedule-health review, critical-path and dependency analysis, milestone outlook, constraint or work-breakdown review, progress consistency check, overdue work, project risks, or near-term lookahead. The agent can prepare a concise project-manager brief. When requested, Microsoft 365 Copilot can create a temporary downloadable Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or PDF report. With your authorization, it can also use relevant files, email, and Teams conversations available in Microsoft 365 Copilot as context; the selected project plan remains the source for schedule facts.

This is a read-only analysis assistant. It does not create or modify project plans, write changes back to OneDrive or SharePoint, or execute its recommendations. Results depend on the selected file's contents, saved state, supported data, and your access; missing, stale, or unsupported information may limit findings. Generated reports are temporary downloads and are not saved to OneDrive or SharePoint by the agent.

An active PDS account and access to Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams are required to use this app. You also need permission to open the selected MPP file. After your app access is enabled, your PDS account is automatically created and assigned to the Freemium plan when you first sign in through MCP. You can start directly in Microsoft 365 Copilot; no separate PDS web-portal visit or account sign-up is required. If you need to request access, visit https://projectdata.io/project-ai. The PDS portal is also available at https://my.projectdata.ai. Usage is subject to account limits. Help Center: https://pdms.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/categories/40422614580893-ProjectData-AI; Project Manager guide: https://pdms.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/40422698748317-PDS-MPP-Project-Manager. Contact Us: https://projectdata.io/contact-us or support@projectdata.io. Supported language: English.
conversationStarters: Select a Microsoft Project plan to analyze.
Summarize the current project delivery status with traceable task evidence.
Assess schedule health and identify the most important delivery risks.
